args: Trend of stock-count discrepancies within 2025: steady climb or step change?

Did the 24% year-over-year rise in routine stock-count discrepancies climb steadily, or did it step up at a specific point in the year (and is that step explained by more warehouses coming online, or a genuine per-location worsening)?
